summary: SVEC Group is seeking rezoning to replace office space on the eastern portion of York Mills Centre with a new mixed-use podium supporting 40- and 55-storey towers with condominium suites, market-rate rentals, and retail. Designed by Hariri Pontarini Architects for 20 and 36 York Mills Road, the project would be directly connected to York Mills station, and is the tallest proposal in an area of limited development activity in northern Toronto. title: Ontario Line 3 and GO Expansion Transforming Exhibition Station
summary: Exhibition station, on the doorstep of Toronto's Liberty Village, is in the midst of an unprecedented transformation, as work continues to turn the once-modest rail stop into a major interchange. Set to host the western terminus of Ontario Line 3 alongside electrified, more-frequent service on GO Transit's Lakeshore West Line, Exhibition station will serve as a downtown "shoulder station," relieving ever-growing capacity concerns at Union Station.
